Falcons vs Packers DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, September 24 · NFL Week 3 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of September 24, 12:31 AM ET

Bijan Robinson carries the highest SPAGS model projection in Thursday Night Football's Falcons at Packers DraftKings Showdown slate: 19.4 DraftKings points at an $11,800 FLEX salary, or 29.0 at captain for $17,700. Robinson holds the largest share of simulated winning-lineup credit at 68% across 10,000 simulations, including the largest captain share at 23.5%.

Behind Robinson, the next four projections are Jordan Love (16.9, $10,000), Michael Penix Jr. (15.8, $9,000), Drake London (14.1, $8,800) and Christian Watson (12.7, $9,800). Green Bay is a 6.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 44.5, with implied team totals of 25.5 for the Packers and 19 for the Falcons.

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the September 24, 12:31 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Bijan Robinson, ATL RB ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

Bijan Robinson holds 23.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,700 and the 19.4-point SPAGS model projection becomes 29.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 13.7 carries and 5.6 targets. The current projection of 19.4 compares with a saved model baseline of 20.7. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 19.5 points with a simulated floor of 7.3 and a ceiling of 38.5. He holds 68% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 23.5% as the captain and 44.6% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Jordan Love, GB QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Jordan Love holds 12.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 16.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.3 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 10,000 simulations Love averaged 16.7 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 30.7. He holds 66% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.4% as the captain and 53.7% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Drake London, ATL WR ($8,800 FLEX / $13,200 CPT)

Drake London holds 12.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $13,200 and the 14.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 21.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 8.3 targets on 26.3 routes. The current projection of 14.1 compares with a saved model baseline of 13.4. Across 10,000 simulations London averaged 14.0 points with a simulated floor of 4.5 and a ceiling of 29.5. He holds 47% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.3% as the captain and 35.0% in a FLEX spot.
